statements:
CREATE TABLE access_sessions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_access_sessions_token_digest ON access_sessions (token_digest)
CREATE INDEX ix_access_sessions_user_id ON access_sessions (user_id)

CREATE TABLE account_auth_epochs (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE bills (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	amount FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	payment_method VARCHAR(20), 
	remark TEXT, 
	date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	time VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_bills_id ON bills (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_bills_user_date ON bills (user_id, date)
CREATE INDEX ix_bills_user_id ON bills (user_id)

CREATE TABLE categories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	icon VARCHAR(10), 
	color VARCHAR(20), 
	is_custom BOOLEAN, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_categories_id ON categories (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_categories_user_id ON categories (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_categories_user_type ON categories (user_id, type)

CREATE TABLE external_identities (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	subject_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_external_subject UNIQUE (provider, subject_digest), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_external_user_provider UNIQUE (user_id, provider)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_external_identities_user_id ON external_identities (user_id)

CREATE TABLE fitness_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	calories INTEGER, 
	date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	time VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_fitness_records_id ON fitness_records (id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fitness_records_user_id ON fitness_records (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fitness_user_date ON fitness_records (user_id, date)

CREATE TABLE identity_rate_buckets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	key_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_identity_rate_bucket UNIQUE (scope, key_digest)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_identity_rate_buckets_window_start ON identity_rate_buckets (window_start)

CREATE TABLE memories (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(200), 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_memory_source UNIQUE (user_id, source, source_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_memories_user_id ON memories (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_memories_user_occurred ON memories (user_id, occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE memory_suppressions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_memory_suppression UNIQUE (user_id, source, source_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_memory_suppressions_user_id ON memory_suppressions (user_id)

CREATE TABLE settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	monthly_budget FLOAT, 
	fitness_daily_goal_minutes INTEGER, 
	fitness_daily_goal_calories INTEGER, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_settings_id ON settings (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_settings_user_id ON settings (user_id)

CREATE TABLE source_controls (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(64), 
	lease_expires_at INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_source_control_user_source UNIQUE (user_id, source), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_control_source CHECK (source = 'coros'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_control_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_control_generation CHECK (generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_source_control_lease_pair CHECK ((lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL) OR (lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_source_controls_user_id ON source_controls (user_id)

CREATE TABLE sync_states (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	last_success_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sync_state_user_source UNIQUE (user_id, source)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_sync_states_user_id ON sync_states (user_id)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_users_id ON users (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)
